text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! There's a rare monster figure for
sale!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mun-mun, it's so cute! I can't let this
chance get
away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And... click! It's all mine. My wallet's
certainly
hurting, though...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna to have to cut back on the
junk food for a while. That means no
more snacking in the
shopping district
either...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Matikanetannhauser
unintentionally
succeeds in her diet.
